steps.name: Harmonia's Necklace (1)
steps.objective: After talking to El in "White Call Canyon", go to [Harmonia] in "Belos of Memories".

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you thinking that you can't even hear me calling you?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ah, you're here. What's going on?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I feel like I didn't properly say thank you for this.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: No. I actually learned more.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Should I call this a worry? . I have something to tell you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know if I can help, but I'll listen for now.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Also, you need help.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this story that makes you so scared? Is there a ghost next to me?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ugh, ugh. Well, stop it!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's a ghost.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'm embarrassed to show you like this. ha… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: After meeting Jenna, I began to see things that were invisible to me. I thought it was just Jenna... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Iris You can also see the door to the imaginary world that appears to belong to you. You can see the spirits inside.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I have seen spirits that sometimes materialize and appear. It's different because it appears before humans through the will of the spirits.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: How about %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm fine. It just so happened… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I am not like that. Although it is different from wool, which has excellent inspiration... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why is El, who fought and won against demons, afraid of ghosts and spirits?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I don't know if it was because my older brother scared me when I was young.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what you're saying is that you don't want to see it. Then Jenna… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Is there a way to only see Jenna and not others?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (You look really desperate. Then….)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will come back after meeting the Spirit King.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Okay, thank you. I will take care of it, so please ask!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's okay. I said I would help you, so I'll be right back!

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: We will be waiting with joy!

steps.name: Harmonia's Necklace (2)
steps.objective: Defeat [Snake Shadow] at “Star of Nothingness” and obtain <Snake Shadow Horn> and <Snake Shadow Scale>. And report to [Harmonia] in '"Belos of Memories"".

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Welcome, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Harmonia, I’m here to ask you a favor.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Is this by any chance L’s story?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Does Harmonia know El?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes, I said it before... I know a certain amount of things related to the people at Luman.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then the story will be faster.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: What makes El fearful is the influence of the relic. He is almost invincible to beings he can see, but he is afraid of things he cannot see.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The Flame of Truth... Well, if it's the influence of ancient artifacts, that could be the case.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: If you suddenly see something you couldn't see before, you might feel anxious. but… .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But what?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: El is a special case, so it might be a little difficult to suddenly make such beings invisible.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, what should I do… .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I'll make you some medicine instead.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Medicine?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Eating it gives you some control. You can erase things you don't want to see... . I can make it for you with the help of the necklace... .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I'm worried that I'll disappoint you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it because of side effects or something?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: No. There are no side effects.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wouldn't that be ok then?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Please be sure to ask L when you bring her medicine. I will make it for you, but taking the medicine is entirely L's choice. Some choices are bound to leave regrets.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will. But can you make it right away?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I think it will be difficult right away. I need materials, so Adventurer has to get them for me. Bring it to me and I will purify it with the power of the necklace.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What materials do you need?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: I need traces of the fake snake that Adventurer encountered. All you need is one scale and one horn.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You can give what you have, or if you don't have it, you can get it quickly if you look for it somewhere.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Then, could you please leave the mental world and come back with the materials? I can't explain it in words, but it's because of the influence of the necklace's power.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah, yes. I will. See you later then.
(As Adventurer leaves the world of images, Geass slowly walks next to Harmonia.)

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: He came and went. It definitely feels different than before.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: You felt it. Adventurer is definitely… .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: Harmonia.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes… .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I don't know what you're thinking. Still, you are doing your best in your position, so I won't say anything else.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: I commend you for giving people who need medicine a choice.

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: As I said before, I hope that the choice of the necklace Leda gave me is not an unfortunate one. If it is a misfortune, we must help.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Geass… .

lines.speaker: 기아스
lines.text: No matter what you say, it's a planned procedure. You and I are both spirits born from the hand of God. You have to accept it.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Yes… .

steps.name: Harmonia's Necklace (3)
steps.objective: Talk to [Harmonia] in "Belos of Memories" and go to [El] in "White Call Canyon".

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Ah, you're here. Adventurer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I brought the items you requested.
(Harmonia takes the horn and scales and gathers them in her hand along with the necklace she was holding.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Please wait a moment.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Take your time.
(After a while, the horns and scales change shape and turn into small white beads.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: The will to create has taken on a new form.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Creation?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ah... Ouroboros?

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: It's just a part of Ouroboros, using its will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: … Harmonia knew too.

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: For us, what we don’t know may be more difficult.
(Harmonia hands over a small jewel created in her hand.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Please bring this to El. And please be sure to ask.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes, I will. Thank you, Harmonia. and… .

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Adventurer, I trust you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well then, I'll go to El. Thank you, Harmonia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I forgot what I was going to say for a moment after hearing Harmonia's words. But what was I going to say..)
(When Adventurer disappeared through the door of the world of images, the calm Harmonia collapsed.)

lines.speaker: 하르모니아
lines.text: Is this what Leda was talking about? What exactly does this necklace want... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I waited.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I went there.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Tell El that he received help from Harmonia, the spirit king of harmony and stability.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: There was such a being. %s is truly amazing to be trusted by such a person.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I met many people while coming here in search of Iris. Those who understand me and who I want to understand... .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: That kind of thing is called ‘relationship’.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is that so? tie… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: My brother said that. If you feel that way, you have received a really good gift called a relationship... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. gift… . Oh, now that I think about it, I had a present for L.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: It's the drug you mentioned.
(L takes the medicine and looks at it intently.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Although something that was invisible can become visible immediately, what was visible does not disappear immediately, and although it can be controlled, it does not become completely invisible... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Harmonia said that taking medicine was entirely El's choice. It seems like a kind of request.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Hmm… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: You have selected.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What are you going to do?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'm going to enjoy seeing something I haven't seen for a while. I think it will be more helpful to the sword if I broaden my perspective... .

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Haha. As expected, it’s El-like. If you are El, you will be able to overcome this and take the path of becoming a better sword.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: I'm embarrassed.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: If I take this medicine and there comes a time when I really can't bear it... . I just hope that doesn't happen then.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: My heart felt lighter. Maybe it was my mindset, not the medicine, that was the problem. I will practice here some more.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you for your hard work. I'll go.

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Thank you. See you later then.
(Adventurer leaves White Call Canyon, and El swings her sword to practice.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Wait, who's there? Since when have you been there?

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: (Where is it? Why can't I see it...?)
(A huge attack comes into the abdomen of El, who was on guard. El, shocked, falls down.)

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Ugh… . Ugh… .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: This power must be... … .

lines.speaker: 엘
lines.text: Who killed Brother Elysion... .
(As El loses consciousness and falls down, the medicine in her arms falls out. And the person who attacked El picks it up.)
